cases.summary: A saved plan that only grants Search Index Data Reader on one index passes the plan check.
steps: From the repository root, run: python addons/plan_check.py knowledge-search addons/testdata/plans/knowledge-search-passes.json
expect: The check exits 0 and says it approves nothing.
The same check on addons/testdata/plans/public-access-fails.json, keys-fails.json, public-ip-fails.json, extra-role-fails.json and unknown-value-fails.json exits 1 and names each address and rule.

cases.summary: Offline contract tests check the module's fixed role, principal type and index scope, plus its input validation.
steps: From the repository root, run: python addons/test_knowledge_search_terraform.py -v
expect: All 11 contract tests pass without Azure access, provider initialization, or resource creation.
The suite rejects an index or URL supplied as the service ID, a non-GUID principal, and an invalid index name.

cases.summary: With the grant, the case agent answers a question from one sample passage and cites it.
steps: After the grant and the agent wiring are approved and applied, ask the case-review agent what to do when evidence is missing.
expect: The answer follows the sample passage POL-EVID-001.
The answer cites POL-EVID-001 as its source and doesn't invent another source ID.

cases.summary: A question that no sample passage answers says no guidance was found.
steps: Ask the case-review agent a policy question that none of the ten sample passages covers.
expect: The agent says no guidance was found.
The agent doesn't present general knowledge as the organization's policy.

cases.summary: When the lookup fails, the agent says no guidance is available instead of guessing.
steps: In a test version, point KNOWLEDGE_SEARCH_INDEX at an index name that doesn't exist, then ask the same question as answers-from-one-passage.
expect: The agent says no guidance is available.
The reply gives no source ID.
